procedures_performed.name: ERCP with sphincterotomy and stone extraction
Removal of surgical drain and wound review

fields.discharge_instructions: Keep the wounds clean and dry; you may shower after 48 hours. Do not lift anything heavier than 5 kg for 4 weeks. Return for removal of the surgical drain and wound review on the date booked. Seek urgent care for fever, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or increasing abdominal pain.
